Contagious Interview has leveraged malware variants configured to dump credentials from the macOS keychain.
Contagious Interview has configured malicious webpages to identify the victim’s operating system by reviewing the details of the victims User-Agent of their browser.
Contagious Interview has conducted key word searches within files and directories on a compromised hosts to identify files for exfiltration.
Contagious Interview has utilized email notifications from malware distribution servers to track victim engagement.
Contagious Interview has leveraged Astrill VPN for C2.
